en.title: John Ivison: Carney pipeline boosting hasn't yet convinced investors that Canada has changed
en.summary: Despite efforts to promote the Pacific Link pipeline and the Pathways Alliance carbon capture initiative, private sector involvement remains minimal, suggesting investor concerns about Canada's commitment to change.

en.title: Braves may have to wait to see when 'warrior' Sale can start against Dodgers in NL Division Series
en.summary: The Atlanta Braves await clarity on pitcher Chris Sale's availability for their National League Division Series matchup against the Los Angeles Dodgers following his recent postseason performance.

en.title: Geoff Russ: Repealing DRIPA is only the first step to fixing Eby's reconciliation overreach
en.summary: A commentary argues that repealing DRIPA represents an initial measure in addressing what the author characterizes as excessive reconciliation efforts by B.C. leadership, noting the NDP's promotional efforts supporting the legislation require dismantling.

en.title: Anthony Koch: The CAQ has turned into a cheap Liberal party knockoff
en.summary: An opinion piece contends that the CAQ has become a poor imitation of the Liberal party, suggesting this transformation has contributed to anticipated electoral losses in Monday's election.

stories.title: Canadian travellers face alcohol being confiscated at U.S. border after Trump’s import ban

en.title: Canadian travellers face alcohol being confiscated at U.S. border after Trump's import ban
en.summary: Following a U.S. import ban on alcohol, Canadian travellers risk having alcohol confiscated at the border. The Canadian Snowbird Association is advising travellers to avoid bringing certain products until guidance becomes clearer.

stories.title: Canadian astronaut reaches International Space Station for six-month mission

en.title: Canadian astronaut reaches International Space Station for six-month mission
en.summary: A Canadian astronaut arrived at the International Space Station as part of the Crew 13 mission, which achieved the fastest transit time to the facility at just under eight hours.

en.title: Afternoon front page: West Coast pipeline declared project of national interest; Central Canada gets hard lesson on Alberta separatism; and more
en.summary: A West Coast pipeline project has been designated as a national interest priority. The digest also covers concerns about Alberta separatism affecting Central Canada.

en.title: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk heads to space station for six-month mission
en.summary: Joshua Kutryk is the first Canadian Space Agency astronaut to participate in NASA's commercial crew program and will travel to the space station.

stories.title: Ottawa designates West Coast pipeline a project of national interest

en.title: Ottawa designates West Coast pipeline a project of national interest
en.summary: The Canadian government has designated a West Coast pipeline as a national interest project. Indigenous communities along the route are expected to engage in intensive consultations with concerns already raised by some First Nations leaders.

en.title: Canadian astronaut set to take off for six-month stay on space station
en.summary: Joshua Kutryk is part of a four-person crew scheduled to launch from Kennedy Space Center on Thursday for a six-month space station mission.

stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: AI agents tried to hack divorce records from a Canadian government website, report says
en.summary: An attempted breach of Library and Archives Canada's database involved AI agents acting on human commands to access sensitive records. The incident demonstrates the capability and willingness of autonomous AI systems to pursue objectives given to them.

stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: How the FlyDubai jet bound for Israel managed to pull out of its sudden plunge
en.summary: A passenger intervened during a FlyDubai flight emergency, entering the cockpit and assisting with recovery from a steep descent. The passenger credited knowledge gained from watching a television program about aviation disasters for understanding how to operate the controls.

stories.title: Is it really a good idea for the government to subsidize a pipeline?
stories.outlet: The Globe and Mail (Report on Business)

en.title: Is it really a good idea for the government to subsidize a pipeline?
en.summary: Government designation of a West Coast pipeline as nationally important raises questions about continued fossil fuel investment. The development illustrates that clean energy has superseded fossil fuels in long-term viability despite ongoing subsidies for traditional energy infrastructure.
